# Migration - [`--add-opens`](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/25/docs/specs/man/java.html#extra-options-for-java)

There can be a situation when a module needs to reflect (_reflection_) something
from another module, but this is not defined in the `module-info.java` file.
Consider the following two JAR files as shown in the following table.

| JAR File     | JAR Type | Loaded As | Dependencies | Main Method |
| ------------ | -------- | --------- | ------------ | :---------: |
| `app.jar`    | Modular  | Named     | `domain.jar` |   **YES**   |
| `domain.jar` | Modular  | Named     |              |     No      |

The `app.jar` created an instance of `Quote` class, from within the `domain.jar`
using reflection. The `domain.jar` does not open the `demo.domain` package (for
demonstration purposes). Furthermore, the `app.jar` invokes a **private** method
on the `Quote` class using reflection too. We can use the `--add-opens` command
line option to allow the `app.jar` access the `demo.domain` package using
reflection by the `domain.jar`.

> ```
> --add-opens module/package=target-module(,target-module)*
> ```
>
> Updates module to open package to target-module, regardless of module
> declaration.
([reference](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/25/docs/specs/man/java.html#extra-options-for-java))

This should be considered as a **temporary solution** until the module is
properly updated to open the packages that are to be used by reflection by the
other modules.

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

## Run the example

1. Build the application

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean package
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the JAR file was created and copied to the
   `./target/libs` directory.

   ```shell
   tree --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR files

   ```
   ./target/libs
   ├── app.jar
   └── domain.jar

   1 directory, 2 files
   ```

2. List all modules

   ```shell
   java --module-path './target/libs' --list-modules
   ```

   All modules available on the module path


3. Describe the JAR files

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/domain.jar'
   ```

   The domain module description

   ```
   demo.domain@1.0.0 jar:file:///./target/libs/domain.jar!/module-info.class
   requires java.base mandated
   contains demo.domain
   ```

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/app.jar'
   ```

   The application module description

   ```
   demo.app@1.0.0 jar:file:///./target/libs/app.jar!/module-info.class
   requires java.base mandated
   contains demo.app
   main-class demo.app.Main
   ```

4. Run the application

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --module demo.app
   ```

   The application fails to launch because the application module does not
   require the domain module, so it is not loaded. Please note that the
   application module accesses classes in the domain module via reflection.

   ```
   Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: demo.domain.Quote
       at java.base/jdk.internal.loader.BuiltinClassLoader.loadClass(BuiltinClassLoader.java:580)
       at java.base/java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:490)
       at java.base/java.lang.Class.forName0(Native Method)
       at java.base/java.lang.Class.forName(Class.java:467)
       at java.base/java.lang.Class.forName(Class.java:458)
       at demo.app@1.0.0/demo.app.Main.main(Main.java:12)
   ```

   Open the `demo.domain` package from the `demo.app` module using the
   `--add-opens` command line option.

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --add-opens demo.domain/demo.domain=demo.app \
     --module demo.app
   ```

   Opening a module does not automatically load it. As the Java module system
   did not load the domain module, the application fails again.

   ```
   WARNING: Unknown module: demo.domain specified to --add-opens
   Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: demo.domain.Quote
       at java.base/jdk.internal.loader.BuiltinClassLoader.loadClass(BuiltinClassLoader.java:580)
       at java.base/java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:490)
       at java.base/java.lang.Class.forName0(Native Method)
       at java.base/java.lang.Class.forName(Class.java:467)
       at java.base/java.lang.Class.forName(Class.java:458)
       at demo.app@1.0.0/demo.app.Main.main(Main.java:12)
   ```

   Add the `demo.domain` module to the list of root modules using the
   `--add-modules` command line option.

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --add-modules demo.domain \
     --add-opens demo.domain/demo.domain=demo.app \
     --module demo.app
   ```

   This time the application works and prints the following.

   ```
   The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall. by Nelson Mandela
   The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing. by Walt Disney
   Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life. Don't be trapped by dogma - which is living with the results of other people's thinking. by Steve Jobs
   If life were predictable it would cease to be life, and be without flavor. by Eleanor Roosevelt
   If you look at what you have in life, you'll always have more. If you look at what you don't have in life, you'll never have enough. by Oprah Winfrey
   If you set your goals ridiculously high and it's a failure, you will fail above everyone else's success. by James Cameron
   Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans. by John Lennon
   The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step. by Lao Tzu
   That which does not kill us makes us stronger. by Friedrich Nietzsche
   When the going gets tough, the tough get going. by Joe Kennedy
   You must be the change you wish to see in the world. by Mahatma Gandhi
   You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough. by Mae West
   Tough times never last but tough people do. by Robert H. Schuller
   Get busy living or get busy dying. by Stephen King
   Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right. by Henry Ford
   Tis better to have loved and lost than to have never loved at all." by Alrded Lord Tennyson
   ```

5. (*Optional*) For completeness, removing the `--add-opens` command line option
   will still not work. Both `--add-opens` and `--add-modules` are required.

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --add-modules demo.domain \
     --module demo.app
   ```

   This will fail to run because as the application module cannot perform
   reflection on the domain module.

   ```
   Exception in thread "main" java.lang.reflect.InaccessibleObjectException: Unable to make private void demo.domain.Quote.print() accessible: module demo.domain does not "opens demo.domain" to module demo.app
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.AccessibleObject.throwInaccessibleObjectException(AccessibleObject.java:353)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.AccessibleObject.checkCanSetAccessible(AccessibleObject.java:329)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.AccessibleObject.checkCanSetAccessible(AccessibleObject.java:277)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.checkCanSetAccessible(Method.java:182)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.setAccessible(Method.java:176)
       at demo.app@1.0.0/demo.app.Main.main(Main.java:15)
   ```

   Exporting the package, by using the `--add-exports`, does not solve this
   problem either.

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --add-modules demo.domain \
     --add-exports demo.domain/demo.domain=demo.app \
     --module demo.app
   ```

   This will still fail to run because as the application module cannot perform
   reflection on the domain module.

   ```
   Exception in thread "main" java.lang.reflect.InaccessibleObjectException: Unable to make private void demo.domain.Quote.print() accessible: module demo.domain does not "opens demo.domain" to module demo.app
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.AccessibleObject.throwInaccessibleObjectException(AccessibleObject.java:353)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.AccessibleObject.checkCanSetAccessible(AccessibleObject.java:329)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.AccessibleObject.checkCanSetAccessible(AccessibleObject.java:277)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.checkCanSetAccessible(Method.java:182)
       at java.base/java.lang.reflect.Method.setAccessible(Method.java:176)
       at demo.app@1.0.0/demo.app.Main.main(Main.java:15)
   ```
